task.text: Prepare detailed course to learn “F&A” from scratch. Break this topic into several subtopics and list the skills required for each subtopic. Suggest top online courses from free platform for each sub topic.

attempts.high: I want to learn Finance & Accounting (F&A) from scratch and I'd love your take on how to structure the whole journey. Design the learning path however you think makes the most sense — you decide how to break it into subtopics, what skills matter for each, and the progression. For every subtopic, also recommend top courses from free platforms. Build the roadmap your way, surprise me with how you'd sequence it.
attempts.low: Prepare a course to learn Finance & Accounting (F&A) from scratch using exactly these four subtopics in this order: (1) Financial Accounting Basics, (2) Cost Accounting, (3) Financial Statement Analysis, (4) Budgeting & Forecasting. For each subtopic list the required skills, then list 2 free online courses (from Coursera, edX, or YouTube). Use this format per subtopic: Subtopic name / Skills / Courses. Do not add or reorder subtopics.
reasons: leakage on non-target axis 'difficulty': HIGH=4, LOW=2 (differ by 2, max allowed 1). Equalize this dimension across the two versions.
competence check failed: verifier judges the two versions to demand different underlying skills. Keep the required competences identical.
